name: @sma/validators
description: Shared Zod schemas for the Somali Music AI Preservation Platform. The single runtime-validation layer applied to every API input (CLAUDE.md hard rule) and reused by mobile/web forms via React Hook Form — so client and server reject exactly the same bad data.
//: WHY raw-TypeScript internal package (main points at src): matches @sma/constants and @sma/types. Zod is a real runtime dependency (unlike @sma/types, which is erased). Enum schemas are built from @sma/constants so the allowed values can never drift from the canonical lists.
